title: Build, independently audit, and re-freeze an ADR-0020-truthful SRD candidate
description:
Own the final candidate/regression/audit/re-freeze sequence under ADR 0020. The candidate
must preserve deterministic regeneration and source fidelity, disposition every known
finding, truthfully describe audit/readiness scope, verify capabilities actually in force,
and expose unresolved discovery/adjudication limits. Universal clause migration,
zero engine-pending, and universal discovery proof are not required.
acceptance_criteria:
- Candidate pack regenerates deterministically and satisfies source/license/provenance invariants.
- Every known finding is explicitly dispositioned with permanent evidence appropriate to its current invariant.
- Automated artifacts state bounded denominators/non-claims and cannot false-green unknown/unclassified results.
- Capabilities in force are source-faithful, bound, provider-neutral, fail closed, and state-correct.
- Independent audit finds no unresolved blocker against the ADR-0020 truthfulness bar.
- Re-freeze makes no global deterministic-closure or universal-discovery claim.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
ADR-0020 authority reconciliation applied 2026-09-10 by eshyra-o9bd.19.6.5.
The operative title/description/acceptance criteria supersede contradictory
pre-ADR global-closure language in older notes. Historical notes remain evidence,
not current authority.
